flag.prompt: Ask once and leave, without a conversation
flag.runtime: claude, codex, kimi, pi…; vibevalley is VibeValley's own agent
flag.cwd: Which folder; the current one when empty
flag.ownCwd: Which folder the own agent works in; the current one when empty
flag.name: The own agent's name (its home is ~/.vibevalley/agent/<name>)
flag.ownModel: The model; the configuration's when empty
flag.mcp: The MCP configuration file; mcp.json in the home when empty
flag.server: The server's address; VIBEVALLEY_SERVER when empty, else the one running on this machine (the home's server.json), else {fallback}
flag.dryRun: Only say what it would do, without doing it (commands that delete, merge, close or send a helper away)
flag.json: The request body: JSON text, - to read stdin, @file to read a file
flag.watch: Keep watching: one JSON line per frame
flag.format: md: Markdown to read (the default); json: the endpoint's answer
flag.capturePage: At the end of this page (its title, slug or an alias); none: today's journal
flag.day: Which day's journal, YYYY-MM-DD; none: today

command.runtimeChat: Talk to a machine directly, not through VibeValley: no trajectory, no spending
command.root: With no command, talk to VibeValley's own agent; every other command calls one of VibeValley's endpoints and answers JSON
command.issueWork: Move a backlog ticket to To do, wait for it to come back and print its changes; each status passed goes to stderr

app.about: The desktop app itself: its status, a page to open, updates, quitting
app.status: Which desktop app this is, its version and where its farm is
app.open: Bring the desktop window to this page (/issues/12), opening the app if it is not
app.quit: Quit the desktop app (its server saves first)
app.update: The desktop app's update: as it stands with no argument, check to look now, install to put it in place and restart

command.doctor: See this machine's farm at once: which one was found, whether it answers, the desktop app, runtimes, the model's key, the LAN listener

pkm.capture: Note something in today's journal (--page: on that page); no words reads stdin, lines split into blocks by indentation
pkm.search: Search the notes: a hit a line, page › where: block
pkm.radar: What wants a look: the inbox, projects left alone, what is overdue
pkm.pageGet: A page as Markdown to read: refs read out, remarks taken off
pkm.pageEdit: Edit a whole page's file in $EDITOR; it is saved when the editor closes

next.help: See how this command is written
next.startServer: Start the server first (vp run --filter @vibevalley/server start), or point --server at one that runs
next.openApp: Open the desktop app first (vibevalley app open opens it too)

failure.shape: The answer does not fit its Schema: {why}
failure.dryRun: {op} changes things, but has no dry run: drop --dry-run to do it
failure.retry: The server asked the stream to reconnect; the command line does not
failure.gone: Ticket #{n} is gone: it was deleted
failure.missingArgument: <{name}> is missing: give it after the command, or in --json
failure.appNotOpen: Cannot reach the desktop app of {home}: {why}

chat.compacted: (the conversation so far was compacted into a summary; the original is in {archive})
chat.usage: {aborted, select, true {(stopped, input {input}, cached {cached}, output {output})} other {(input {input}, cached {cached}, output {output})}}
chat.hello: {skills} skills, {tools} MCP tools. /reset forgets the conversation, /exit quits, Ctrl+C stops.
chat.direct: Talking directly: not through VibeValley, no trajectory, no spending. Ctrl+C stops this turn; again when idle quits.

channel.set: Choose the channel a connector's messages go to

title.set: Pick the title shown on the farm card

github.get: Whether gh is installed and logged in

diff.get: A ticket's changes: commits, files and diff

lan.get: Whether connect to this machine is on, and its devices

lan.update: Turn connect to this machine on or off

memory.create: Add a memory to a profile
memory.delete: Delete one of a profile's memories

archive.get: Read one of the manager's archived conversations

comment.list: List remarks and suggested rewrites, one page's if given
